rows.text: with `o` = qword `+0x300` of qword `0209AC30`, returns qword `o+0xD0+ecx*0x10` when `o` is non-null and dword `o+0x168` has bit `ecx` set, testing it through `1 << cl` truncated to 16 bits (so only bits 0-15 can match); otherwise returns 0

clears bit `ecx` of dword `02B59D18` when `edx` is non-zero and sets it when `edx` is 0, storing the result back; when that result is 0 tail-jumps to `003DF7B0` + 0x24, otherwise calls `003DF7B0` + 0x33(0, 0, 0, 0) and zeroes qwords `02B59D00` and `02B59D08` and dwords `02B59D10` and `02B59D14`

notes: 00292050: the index is computed as (sign-extended ecx + 0xD) * 2 qwords, i.e. byte offset 0xD0 + ecx*0x10. 003DF7B0: btr/bts with a register bit offset on a register operand use ecx mod 32.
